response.sql: WITH per_status AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(GOT - GPT) AS avg_ast_alt, AVG(APTT - PT) AS avg_aptt_pt FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC > 6.5 GROUP BY CENTROMEA) SELECT AVG(avg_ast_alt) AS avg_of_ast_alt_averages, AVG(avg_aptt_pt) AS avg_of_aptt_pt_averages FROM per_status

assumptions.assumption: The 6.5 WBC cutoff is a filter that keeps only records with WBC strictly greater than 6.5. The request gives no direction, and records with a missing WBC are excluded.
A NULL CENTROMEA forms its own group. Empty-string or other literal values stay separate groups.

Each difference is averaged only over records where both of its operands are non-null, because AVG skips NULL differences. The two differences are averaged independently, so a record can count toward one but not the other.
The final figures are plain unrounded AVGs over the per-status averages. A status with a NULL average for one measure is ignored for that measure only.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff keeps records with low or normal WBC, meaning WBC at or below 6.5, instead of those above it.
alternatives.sql: WITH per_status AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(GOT - GPT) AS avg_ast_alt, AVG(APTT - PT) AS avg_aptt_pt FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC <= 6.5 GROUP BY CENTROMEA) SELECT AVG(avg_ast_alt) AS avg_of_ast_alt_averages, AVG(avg_aptt_pt) AS avg_of_aptt_pt_averages FROM per_status
